name: Volt Typhoon - TTPs & Detection Coverage
description: MITRE ATT&CK Navigator layer for Volt Typhoon (BRONZE SILHOUETTE / Vanguard Panda). Scores reflect detection coverage from the KQL v1+v2 pack: 3=detected by capstone/high-fidelity rule, 2=detected by single-phase rule, 1=hunting-only or partial coverage, 0=blind spot requiring additional telemetry.

metadata.name: Aliases
metadata.value: BRONZE SILHOUETTE, Vanguard Panda, DEV-0391, UNC3236, Voltzite, Insidious Taurus

metadata.name: Target Sectors
metadata.value: US critical infrastructure - communications, energy, transportation, water

metadata.name: Detection Pack
metadata.value: KQL v1 + v2 - 11 queries across Defender XDR / Sentinel

techniques.comment: Exploit Public-Facing Application. Volt Typhoon exploits Fortinet FortiGuard, Ivanti, and other internet-facing devices. BLIND SPOT for KQL on endpoints - requires WAF/IDS/edge syslog.
External Remote Services. Uses valid credentials against VPNs and RDP. Needs identity provider logs (Azure AD/Okta) + VPN telemetry.
Valid Accounts. Partial coverage via account anomaly hunting; full coverage requires UEBA.
Domain Accounts - the account used in the cross-device capstone correlation.
Command and Scripting Interpreter - Discovery query catches cmd/wmic invocations.
PowerShell - covered by v2 Encoded PowerShell detection with multi-layer scoring.
Windows Command Shell - covered by Discovery and capstone queries.
WMI - Impacket wmiexec pattern (cmd spawned by wmiprvse + ADMIN$ output) is high-fidelity.
Scheduled Task. Not in current pack - flagged for v3 persistence query set.
Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder. BLIND SPOT - needs persistence query set.
WMI Event Subscription. BLIND SPOT - needs persistence query set.
Account Manipulation. Not covered.
Local Accounts - account anomaly hunting.
Obfuscated Files or Information - covered by v2 Encoded PowerShell scoring rule.
Command Obfuscation - explicitly scored by the Encoded PowerShell query.
Masquerading - .gif rename trick caught by FileRenamed query.
Match Legitimate Name or Location - archive renamed to image extension.
Masquerade File Type - .dit hiding as .gif.
Indicator Removal. BLIND SPOT - needs Event 1102/104 query set.
Clear Windows Event Logs. BLIND SPOT - needs tamper detection query.
System Binary Proxy Execution - wmic call create caught by capstone.
Disable or Modify Tools - needs EDR tamper detection.
OS Credential Dumping - parent technique. Multiple sub-techniques covered.
NTDS - ntdsutil IFM detection is high-fidelity. THE signature Volt Typhoon detection.
DCSync - covered by v2 Event 4662 + Schema-Id-GUID query. Essentially zero false positives.
LSASS Memory - rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump in alt-dump query. Other variants not covered.
Security Account Manager - reg save HKLM\SAM in alt-dump query.
LSA Secrets - reg save HKLM\SECURITY in alt-dump query.
Unsecured Credentials - registry/file searching for creds. Not covered.
Credentials from Password Stores. Not covered.
Account Discovery - net group/net localgroup caught by Discovery query.
Local Account discovery.
Domain Account - net group /dom and net group Domain Admins.
System Network Configuration Discovery - ip-api.com / ipinfo.io / ipconfig.
Remote System Discovery - nltest, net view. Partial coverage.
System Information Discovery - systeminfo, wmic logicaldisk.
Process Discovery - tasklist /svc.
System Network Connections Discovery - netstat. Partial coverage.
System Owner/User Discovery - query user, whoami.
Domain Groups - net group Domain Admins enumeration.
Remote Services - RDP/SMB usage. Partial.
SMB/Windows Admin Shares - Impacket pattern writing to ADMIN$.
Windows Remote Management. Partial.
Lateral Tool Transfer - SMB copy. Partial via file events.
Archive Collected Data - 7zip/rar staging query.
Archive via Utility - 7z.exe, rar.exe with password (-mhe -p).
Data from Local System. Partial.
Proxy - netsh portproxy detection plus registry corroboration.
Internal Proxy - the signature Volt Typhoon TTP. High-fidelity coverage.
Multi-hop Proxy - KV-botnet via SOHO routers. Partial - needs NDR/NetFlow.
Protocol Tunneling - FRP/Earthworm. Partial - needs network telemetry.
Web Protocols. Not covered without network telemetry.
Ingress Tool Transfer - downloading tools. Not covered.
Exfil over C2 Channel. Partially observable via .gif rename detection but transmission itself blind.
Exfil over Web Service. Not covered without proxy/NDR logs.
Resource Hijacking - not the Volt Typhoon goal. They pre-position for disruption.
